visualCharacteristics.purpose: In-article 16:9 video in the text column
visualCharacteristics.description: Poster image with a centred round blue play button. YouTube videos play inline; Mayo-hosted (Kaltura) videos open on mayoclinic.org. The H3 title and a "Show transcript" accordion-toggle follow as separate content.

contentPattern.structure: One cell: optional poster image + video link
contentPattern.description: YouTube: author https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID; with a poster the iframe loads on click, without one it loads near the viewport. Kaltura: signed player links expire, so author the stable thumbnail as the poster plus a link to the source page on mayoclinic.org; the poster links out. A direct .mp4/.webm link plays in a native player.
contentPattern.blockContent: In-article video (poster with play button, or YouTube iframe), then an H3 video title and a Show transcript expander

usage: Video embedded in article body text, followed by a default-content H3 title and an accordion-toggle transcript.
reuseGuidance: Use for in-article videos. Keep hero-video for full-bleed background video in a hero band.
userDecision: Mayo-hosted (Kaltura) videos: author the stable thumbnail as the poster plus a link that opens the video on mayoclinic.org (signed links expire). YouTube videos play inline.
